title: SMB signing not required on file server
description: The file server accepts unsigned SMB sessions, enabling relay attacks.
remediation: Require SMB signing via group policy.

title: Unsupported operating system on reception workstation
description: Workstation runs an operating system version without security updates.

title: LLMNR and NBT-NS enabled on client network
description: Name resolution poisoning captured password hashes during the test.
remediation: Disable LLMNR and NBT-NS by group policy.

title: Weak password policy in directory service
description: Minimum password length is 6 with no complexity requirement.
remediation: Enforce a 12+ character minimum and screen against breached passwords.
